title: Currency - Currency Module Data Models Reference

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the Currency data model. It belongs to the Currency Module.

types.name: code
types.description: The ISO 3-character currency code. For example, `USD`.

types.name: symbol
types.description: The symbol of the currency. For example, `$`.

types.name: symbol_native
types.description: The native symbol of the currency, if it has a different local symbol.

types.name: decimal_digits
types.description: How many digits are after the decimal separator for prices in this currency.

types.name: rounding
types.description: The rounding percision of prices in this currency.
